author: Dawudis
body:
Greetings Avicus Staff, I am Midnight/Ender and I wanted to explain what happened during the "combat logging" incident. See, my computer had a light computer overdrive which happens frequently when I leave my computer on for too long. So I had crashed. I have to inform you, that I wasn't even in combat when I crashed off the game. I had accidentally fell off the world when I did a parkour fail across the bridge on Halcyon. Plus I had already learned that lesson when I got banned for combat logging last time, and I do not want to do that again. So if you could accept my ban appeal that would be great. :)

Regards,
Midnight/Ender

Now my recording may have glitched but I still have the recording just before and right (and I mean righttttt) after you use /leave when falling into the void. You are right that you were not in combat but that does not matter.
